summary: Aligns primitive groups to each other or to an auxiliary input by translating and/or rotating primitives around chosen UV pivots.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Primitive group pattern to align; blank aligns the full input

key_params.name: align
key_params.note: Align all primitives, groups of N primitives, or skip every Nth primitive

key_params.name: inc
key_params.note: Group or skip count for Align mode

key_params.name: bias
key_params.note: Controls which side remains fixed: 0 left, 1 right

key_params.name: leftuv
key_params.note: Pivot location on each left primitive

key_params.name: rightuv
key_params.note: Pivot location on each right primitive

key_params.name: rightuvend
key_params.note: Auxiliary-input end location used to distribute left primitives

key_params.name: individual
key_params.note: Align each primitive independently instead of aligning only the first and preserving relative layout

common_gotchas: Left/right primitive meaning changes when an auxiliary input is connected; the auxiliary input is always the right side.
Disable Individual Alignment when the relative spatial layout of the left primitives must be preserved.
Alignment works on primitives, not arbitrary point clouds; verify primitive grouping before planning a snap operation.
key_concepts: Align SOP translates and/or rotates primitive groups so left and right primitive UV pivots line up.
With an auxiliary input connected, the auxiliary primitive is always treated as the right-side target.
The align mode can process every primitive, grouped primitives, or skip patterns based on the increment.
Optional transform parameters can apply a post-align transform after the primitive alignment step.
